attributes.board_name: Puerto Rico Board of Medical Licensure and Discipline (Junta de Licenciamiento y Disciplina Médica)

topics.who: All physicians: bioethics and professionalism covering discrimination against older adults, women, people with disabilities, LGBTTQ+ community, diversity and social inclusion (Resolution 2026-117)

rules.alternatives: Physicians residing in the U.S. who want to keep the PR license: valid state license and good standing exempt them from the listed courses (the same sheet also asks U.S.-practicing PR licensees for 60 CME hours). Residents/fellows in ACGME programs: residency certification plus bioethics 3 and medical records 1 credit.
rules.notes: Of the 60: specialists 30 in specialty + 26 free; GPs 56 free; +1 credit medical record documentation (no topic code). Autism: pediatricians 6, autism-center physicians 15. Non-EM ER/primary-care doctors: 20 h life support (ACLS etc.). Credits <0.5 not accepted.
rules.legal_basis: Ley Núm. 139 del 1 de agosto de 2008, según enmendada; Reglamento 8861; Resolución 2026-117
rules.audit_note: Renewal (recertification) needs the sworn Recertification Form, ASUME certificate, criminal background certificate (max 2 months old), malpractice certification; $500 if late.
